input.goal: Add broccoli and green beans to pan and stir

steps.text: Chop the broccoli into smaller pieces
Continue chopping the broccoli into smaller pieces
Transfer the chopped broccoli and other vegetables to the pan
Stir the vegetables in the pan
Continue stirring the vegetables in the pan
Continue stirring the vegetables in the pan
Finish stirring the vegetables and turn off the stove

next_action.text: The step is complete; nothing more needs to be done for it.

choices.A: Continue stirring the vegetables in the pan
choices.B: Continue stirring the vegetables in the pan
choices.C: Finish stirring the vegetables and turn off the stove
choices.D: The step is complete; nothing more needs to be done for it.

object_recognition.definition: The object the camera wearer handles at one moment of a recorded step: ask what is in hand / being manipulated when a visible cue happens. Not the purpose.
object_recognition.evidence_note: evidence_steps are recorded steps that can be shown inside a 30 s clip window; the item asks about what is visible.

action_recognition.definition: What action (verb + object) is performed within one recorded step shown in the clip.
action_recognition.evidence_note: evidence_steps are recorded steps that can be shown inside a 30 s clip window; the item asks about what is visible.

event_object_role.definition: Within one recorded step: which object is acted on, which tool is used, where it goes (destination).
event_object_role.evidence_note: evidence_steps are recorded steps that can be shown inside a 30 s clip window; the item asks about what is visible.

action_temporal_order.definition: Order of recorded steps that are directly shown close together (span <= 15 s).
action_temporal_order.evidence_note: evidence_steps are recorded steps that can be shown inside a 30 s clip window; the item asks about what is visible.

sound_action_binding.definition: Within one recorded sub-goal: which action / object produced a sound heard in the clip.
sound_action_binding.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals containing an annotated sound; pick sounds produced by goal actions (chopping, sizzling, pouring), not background.

inter_event_temporal_reasoning.definition: Order / count / progress across steps spread over the task (span > 15 s): what came before what, how many times an action recurred, which steps are already done by the cutoff.
inter_event_temporal_reasoning.evidence_note: evidence_steps are anchor steps of 60 s windows; the item must integrate at least two steps more than 15 s apart.

goal_conditioned_planning.definition: At the task cutoff: what action to take next (the four official choices) or the next 4-8 steps to finish the task.
goal_conditioned_planning.evidence_note: the clip ends at the task's observation frame (after all recorded steps); 'segment' = the whole recorded progress, 'next' = the official next action, which is the reference answer.

plan_gap_filling.definition: Given the end of sub-goal k and the start of sub-goal k+m, which sub-goals were carried out in between (recorded order); event_refs = [k, k+m].
plan_gap_filling.evidence_note: evidence_steps are HEAD steps k that have a tail step k+m (m = 2, 3 or 4) in this task; an entry's event_refs must be [k, k+m]; the Solver sees only the last seconds of k and the first seconds (or frame) of k+m and must name the hidden steps in between.

cross_event_integration.definition: Combine evidence from two moments of the task far apart in time (two short segments, span 20 s - several minutes): what carried over, what changed, counts across both; event_refs = [head, tail].
cross_event_integration.evidence_note: evidence_steps are HEAD sub-goals that have a later sub-goal in this task; an entry's event_refs must be [head, tail]; the Solver sees the last 12 s of head and the first 12 s of tail.

hidden_state_inference.definition: The state (on/off, open/closed, covered, plugged) of an appliance or container at the end of a clip, when the last change of that state happened before the clip and is not visible in it.
hidden_state_inference.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals during which a 30 s clip can be cut after an earlier recorded state change (hob/tap/light on-off, door open-closed, pan covered); the item asks the state at the end of that clip.

spatial_state_integration.definition: Which of several objects resting around the kitchen is nearest / farthest to a reference object at the end of the clip, when some of them were put down before the clip (3D resting positions from the dataset).
spatial_state_integration.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals during which a 30 s clip ends with a reference object just put down; candidates are other resting objects with recorded 3D positions.

causal_prerequisite_reasoning.definition: Which earlier recorded sub-goal was a physical prerequisite of the sub-goal shown in the clip (explicit task model; prerequisite declared by the Examiner, candidate reference).
causal_prerequisite_reasoning.evidence_note: evidence_steps are EFFECT sub-goals (idx >= 2) shown in a 30 s clip; the item asks which earlier sub-goal was its physical prerequisite.

spatial_near.definition: At one moment inside a recorded sub-goal: which of the listed objects is nearest / farthest to a reference object (3D positions from the dataset; candidates listed in the question).
spatial_near.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals during which a dataset-derived nearest / farthest relation holds at one moment; pick those whose reference object is an ingredient / tool / container of the goal.

spatial_side.definition: At one moment inside a recorded sub-goal: which of the listed objects is leftmost / rightmost from the camera wearer's viewpoint at that moment.
spatial_side.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals during which a dataset-derived left / right relation (wearer's view) holds at one moment; pick goal objects.

object_location_at_time.definition: Where (on which fixture / surface / container) an object is put down at one moment of a recorded sub-goal.
object_location_at_time.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals in which a recorded put-down happens; pick put-downs of goal objects.

sound_anchored_spatial_near.definition: The moment is fixed by a sound inside a recorded sub-goal; at that moment, which listed object is nearest to the reference object.
sound_anchored_spatial_near.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals where a sound fixes the moment of a derived nearest relation; pick goal objects / goal sounds.

sound_anchored_spatial_side.definition: The moment is fixed by a sound inside a recorded sub-goal; at that moment, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost for the wearer.
sound_anchored_spatial_side.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals where a sound fixes the moment of a derived left / right relation; pick goal objects / goal sounds.

object_state_change.definition: Within one recorded sub-goal: an object's start and end location / state through one movement (where it was taken from, where it went).
object_state_change.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals containing a recorded movement (pick-up -> put-down) of an object; pick goal objects.

sound_movement_binding.definition: Within one recorded sub-goal: which object movement produced / coincides with a sound.
sound_movement_binding.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals where an annotated sound coincides with a recorded object movement; pick goal objects.

inter_event_spatial_extreme.definition: After several placements across sub-goals, which listed object ends nearest / farthest to a reference (needs integrating where things were put in different sub-goals).
inter_event_spatial_extreme.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals whose end has a derived nearest / farthest relation built from earlier placements; pick goal objects.

inter_event_spatial_order.definition: After several placements across sub-goals, the order of the listed objects by distance to a reference.
inter_event_spatial_order.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals whose end has a derived distance order built from earlier placements; pick goal objects.

egocentric_frame_transform.definition: After the wearer puts an object down and then moves or turns, where is that object relative to the wearer at the end of the clip (front/back x left/right, from the wearer's own viewpoint then); needs the clip to show the placement.
egocentric_frame_transform.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals during which a 30 s clip ends after a recorded placement, with the device pose known; the item asks the object's quadrant relative to the wearer at the end.

gaze_primed_next_pickup.definition: Which object the wearer will pick up next, asked just before the pick-up (clip ends 0.3-8 s before it); reference = the recorded pick-up, cue = the wearer's gaze / head turn.
gaze_primed_next_pickup.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals in which a recorded pick-up with gaze priming happens; the clip ends shortly before the pick-up.

object_grounding.definition: Give the bounding box of a named object in the first frame of a 1 s clip (official mask box; IoU scoring).
object_grounding.evidence_note: evidence_steps are the sub-goals containing annotated object masks; the item asks for the box in the first frame of a 1 s clip.
